sn22.151:1.2: kismiṃ nu kho bhikkhave sati kiṃ upādāya kiṃ abhinivissa
sn22.151:1.3: etaṃ mama esohamasmi eso me attāti samanupassatīti.
sn22.151:1.5: rūpe kho bhikkhave sati rūpaṃ upādāya rūpaṃ abhinivissa etaṃ mama esohamasmi eso me attāti samanupassati vedanāya sati. saññāya sati. saṅkhāresu sati.
sn22.151:1.6: viññāṇe sati viññāṇaṃ upādāya viññāṇaṃ abhinivissa
sn22.151:1.7: etaṃ mama esohamasmi eso me attāti samanupassati.
sn22.151:1.11: vipariṇāmadhammaṃ api nu taṃ anupādāya etaṃ mama esohamasmi eso me attāti samanupasseyyāti.
sn22.151:1.18: api nu taṃ anupādāya etaṃ mama esohamasmi eso me attāti samanupasseyyāti.
